name: Tennessee
overview: Tennessee collects unpaid property taxes through a delinquent tax lawsuit: after February 1 but before April 1, the county's delinquent tax attorney files suit in chancery or circuit court. The property is then sold at a court-ordered public sale run by the court clerk, usually the Clerk and Master, and the sale becomes final only when the Chancery Court confirms the Clerk and Master's report of sale. Once the order confirming the sale is entered, the owner and other interested persons may redeem: within one year in most cases, 180 days or 90 days when the taxes were delinquent for more than five or eight years, and 30 days for vacant or abandoned property. Redemption interest is 12% per annum.
